notes.title: Bullets Squared Battle mode is here!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to release the latest major update to Bullets Squared. As promised, it contains the new game mode: Battle.

Battle is a multiplayer mode, with up to 4 players, where you play the same level in parallel, and compete for the highest score. The unique addition to Battle mode, is the option to spend some of your points to send attack squares to your opponents, with the hope of disrupting their combos. You'll have to weigh the amount of points you are willing to sacrifice to mess with your rivals.

The new game mode utilizes simple Steam lobbies for easy game hosting. You can create lobbies for levels you have unlocked, and join them via the in-game lobby browser, or via direct invites through the Steam chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40259735/68e5573c5a2a40882fd0b81815d070415e8dc956.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40259735/5f521e03a32ca3b0c848c98cdbb66dac2c1f3ef2.png[/img]

Currently only Normal game mode is available (Endless is still a work in progress), with any of the three difficulties configurable by the lobby host. Only the host can start the game. If the host leaves the lobby, the role is passed on to the next available player.

In addition to the new game mode, some bugfixes are also be included, including improved progress data validation on version updates, and some graphic glitch fixes.

Detailed changelog:
[list]
[*] Implemented P2P multiplayer through Steamworks
[*] Added new game mode Battle for multiplayer
[*] Added new square types (currently used in Battle mode)
[*] Extended the How to Play screen with Battle mode
[*] Added Battles won counter to the Stats screen
[*] Save game data is revalidated after a version change, levels and achievements are correctly granted retroactively after nerfs or misc. changes
[*] Lighting effects improved, reduced color banding
[*] Video options screen refresh rate selection bug fixed
[*] Misc. engine optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Bullets Squared is getting Multiplayer!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce the next major update to Bullets Squared will include a new game mode: "Battle".

Battle is a multiplayer mode, with up to 4 players, where you play the same level in parallel, and compete for the highest score. The unique addition to Battle mode, is the option to spend some of your points to send attack squares to your opponents, with the hope of disrupting their combos. You'll have to weigh the amount of points you are willing to sacrifice to mess with your rivals.

The new game mode will utilize simple Steam lobbies for easy game hosting, inviting friends to play will be very quick and easy.

In addition to the new game mode, some bugfixes will also be included, including improved progress data validation on version updates (useful if levels get nerfed after being played) and some graphic glitch fixes.

The update should be ready sometime in the next couple weeks. Looking forward to playing with you all :)

notes.title: Bullets Squared v1.1.0 update out now!
notes.notes:
[h2]First significant update[/h2]
The latest update includes the following features and improvements to the game:

[h3]Combo counter and point popups on the game board[/h3]
To be able to keep a closer eye on your combo, you can now have the counter directly next to your main square. It will start showing once you reach a 5x combo.
In addition, you can now also have the earned points pop up when you hit enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40259735/a61356016a33720406749cdd3cc092a391d22702.gif[/img]
Both of these features can be individually enabled or disabled in the game's video settings.

[h3]Improved leaderboard screen[/h3]
The way leaderboards are loaded has been optimized, to reduce the number of network requests, and minimize performance impact when switching between levels in the menu.
The leaderboard screen (accessible by clicking the button to the left of your high score in the level selection screen) now attempts to load all global entries in a scrollable view (up to 1000) instead of just the 10 entries around the player's rank.
In addition to your own score, your steam friends' scores are now also highlighted.

[h3]Level select screen improvements[/h3]
Your highest medal reached for each level is now displayed as a small icon in the level select list. This will help more easily identify not yet completed levels, especially when the number of levels will increase (hint hint).

[h3]Technical improvements[/h3]
The engine has been updated to the latest version of Unity 2020.3.10f1.
Some misc. code optimizations.

[h2]Plans for v1.2.0[/h2]
For the next big update, I'd like to be able to finish at least one of the following:
[list]
[*] New levels
[*] Custom level editor
[*] New game mode
[/list]

If you enjoy the game, it would mean a lot if you could leave a Steam review :)

Have fun!

notes.title: Bullets Squared v1.0.2 patch
notes.notes:
Thanks to some feedback, and leaderboard data, the requirements for bronze medals for some levels have been modified. This should hopefully make the game more accessible for all players, and allow later levels to be more easily unlockable.

The changes should be applied retroactively to already completed levels.

Have fun!

notes.title: Bullets Squared Released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Game released wooo[/h1]
I'm happy to release Bullets Squared today, as a completely free game. I hope you all enjoy your time playing. If you have any feedback please feel free to write on the Community Hub or hit me up on [url=https://twitter.com/eNorby]twitter[/url].
If you like the game, I'd also really appreciate if you could write a review ːcsd2smileː

[h1]Custom levels[/h1]
The game has support for user-generated content. Unfortunately I couldn't finish a publicly available level editor yet, so creating them may require some faffing about. The level editor is planned as a future feature, possibly with Steamworks integration.

But if you are already interested in adding your own levels with your own custom music, you can look at the included example, in your game installation directory, under /Bullets Squared_Data/StreamingAssets/. If there is any interest, I can write up a detailed guide on this.

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
Besides the aformentioned improved custom level support, and potential bug fixes, future updates will probably contain some new levels, and tweaks to the game modes. If you have any fun ideas, that you think would fit the game, feel free to share them as well.

Have fun!
